description: Two stimuli colocated in RF, contrasts covary; attend preferred vs attend nonpreferred. Two solid CRFs: attend-preferred (upper, peak 1.0) sits above attend-nonpreferred (lower, peak ~0.78) with a sustained separation (response-gain-like). Dashed percent-modulation curve stays WITHIN 0-100 in the paper (roughly 40-55, gently declining). KNOWN MODEL DIVERGENCE: the implementation's percent modulation reaches ~300-400%, overflowing this 0-100 axis (intended failing test).
